name: crew
description: A Django crew and a Captain who dispatches them. Agents for planning, refactoring, tests, debugging, UI, QA, security and data loss; a /captain command that plans the passage and runs each agent once; self-loading skills for Django house rules and sensitive-data review; hooks that stop the test-writer discarding your uncommitted work, keep the reviewers out of the database, hold the Gunner and Lookout to their own rules, and catch a leaked template comment or a missing migration before the turn ends.
